segments.label: still
segments.prompt: Hold the phone like a remote, screen up, and keep it still.

segments.label: wiggle
segments.prompt: Wiggle it: tilt and twist every which way, hand in place.

segments.label: tilt-roll
segments.prompt: Roll it left and right (tip the side edges), hand in place.

segments.label: tilt-pitch
segments.prompt: Tip the top edge up and down, hand in place.

segments.label: turn
segments.prompt: Keep it flat and swivel the top edge left and right.

segments.label: move-right
segments.prompt: Keep it level. Move the whole phone ~30 cm right, then hold.

segments.label: move-left
segments.prompt: Keep it level. Move it ~30 cm left, then hold.

segments.label: move-up
segments.prompt: Keep it level. Raise it ~30 cm, then hold.

segments.label: move-down
segments.prompt: Keep it level. Lower it ~30 cm, then hold.

segments.label: slow-drag
segments.prompt: Keep it level. Slowly slide it ~20 cm right over 2 seconds.

segments.label: taps
segments.prompt: Hold it steady and tap the big button 5 times.

segments.label: free
segments.prompt: Point around at the TV however feels natural.
